description: Full list of requirements extracted from the owner's brief, decomposed into testable requirements. Each requirement is mapped to a source where a fact is involved.

requirements.requirement: Collect, organize and analyze NFL data using this full list of requirements as the spec.
Provide a dedicated Suggestions section where a reviewer can review suggestions and choose the best path before any change is implemented.
Provide a clear list of questions, information and answers that must be addressed before any decision, based on what we have and do not have.
Make suggestions aimed specifically at discovering missing information.
Originate NFL lines from our own model, not from a bookmaker feed.
Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals.
Treat the system as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top-performing strategies.
Support single bet, parlay and player-prop bet combination strategies.
Every strategy must pass validation gates before it is eligible.
Determine correlation values between legs/selections.
Remove luck from the equation and build strategies that are selectively skill-based.
Track injuries.
Track deficiencies in defenses when 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups replace starters.
Track offenses using starters or backups.
Produce an executive summary outlining important details.
No manual input: the pipeline runs end-to-end automatically.
Review the repo line by line, verifying from official verified trusted sources, and provide links for manual review.
Flag any irregularities for review.
Create a GitHub Pages live site with a clean landing page.
Subpages organized by category.
Clean, user-friendly, simple dashboard-style UI.
All entries and findings in a simple, easy-to-read table format.
Include analysis and findings.
Every table row must have a source link to an official site.
If a value cannot be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it as unverified.
Never infer or fill in values.
Coordinate parallel sessions through COORDINATION.md; claim tasks and keep non-overlapping scopes.
Create a PR, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy, and log the result.
Include responsible-gaming disclosure; betting is a risk and this is decision-support research, not a wagering service.
